---
title: "Metas"
---

```{=html}
<div class="tf-page-header">
  <div>
    <h1>Metas financieras</h1>
    <div class="tf-muted">Objetivos con prioridad, fecha y aporte mensual recomendado.</div>
  </div>
  <button class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" data-logout>Cerrar sesión</button>
</div>

<a id="goal-emergency-card" class="tf-card tf-goal-emergency-link" href="fondo_emergencia.html" hidden>
  <div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Protección</div><strong>Fondo de emergencia</strong><div id="goal-emergency-detail" class="tf-muted"></div></div>
  <span>→</span>
</a>

<div class="tf-actions" style="margin-top:1rem">
  <button id="goal-new" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary" type="button">Nueva meta</button>
  <button id="goal-archived-toggle" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button" hidden>Archivadas</button>
</div>
<dialog id="goal-editor" class="tf-modal-dialog">
  <div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Meta financiera</div><h2 id="goal-editor-title">Nueva meta</h2></div><button id="goal-editor-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div>
  <form id="goal-form" class="tf-form-grid">
    <input id="goal-id" type="hidden">
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Meta</label><input id="goal-name" required></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Objetivo ($)</label><input id="goal-target" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" required></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Fecha objetivo</label><input id="goal-date" type="date"></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Prioridad</label><select id="goal-priority"><option value="high">Alta</option><option value="medium" selected>Media</option><option value="low">Baja</option></select></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Cuenta vinculada</label><select id="goal-account"></select></div>
    <div class="tf-field"><label>Acumulado manual ($)</label><input id="goal-saved" type="number" min="0" step="0.01" value="0"></div>
    <div class="tf-span-2 tf-actions">
      <button id="goal-submit" class="tf-btn tf-btn-primary">Guardar meta</button>
      <button id="goal-cancel" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cancelar</button>
    </div>
  </form>
</dialog>

<div class="tf-table-wrap" style="margin-top:1rem"><table class="tf-table tf-goal-table"><thead><tr><th>Meta</th><th class="tf-num">Objetivo</th><th class="tf-num">Acumulado</th><th class="tf-num">Pendiente</th><th>Fecha objetivo</th><th>Progreso</th><th>Información</th></tr></thead><tbody id="goal-list"></tbody></table></div>
<dialog id="goal-detail-dialog" class="tf-modal-dialog"><div class="tf-modal-head"><div><div class="tf-section-kicker">Meta financiera</div><h2 id="goal-detail-title">Detalle</h2></div><button id="goal-detail-close" class="tf-btn tf-btn-secondary" type="button">Cerrar</button></div><div id="goal-detail-body"></div></dialog>

<script type="module" src="js/goals.js?v=1.0.93"></script>
```
